name: vis
description_en: A vi-like editor based on Plan 9's structural regular expressions
readme_excerpt: Vis - Combining Modal Editing with Structural Regular Expressions Vis aims to be a modern, legacy-free, simple yet efficient editor, combining the strengths of both vi(m) and sam. It extends vi's modal editing with built-in support for multiple cursors/selections and combines it with sam's structural regular expression based command language.
